message: 農業する日曜日

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, time to do my best today too and aim for that sparkling academy life!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hate to rain on your parade when you're all fired up and already in your uniform, Demon Lord, but」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Today's Sunday, ya know」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh」
I guess I've been pretty busy lately with all the stuff for KiraFes.

name: Paqy
message: 「Wanna go back to sleep?」

name: Synn
message: 「I went through the trouble of waking up early, so that'd be a waste」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then how 'bout we do some knitting to get ready for winter? Yours truly wants a belly warmer!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! Today I'll--」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the last of the onions! Next up is spinach, huh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Someone's here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sasamiii, how ya doing? Synn hasn't eaten you or anything, has he?」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cluck-cluck, bawk, bawk」
It's Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Always full of energy, aren't you. Wish you'd lay a ton of eggs at this rate... though you're a boy, so no luck there. Ah, hey, stop, that tickles」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk, bawk, cock-a-doodle-doo」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'! Working the fields on your day off--you sure are dedicated」

name: Synn
message: 「I finally got some free time, so I'm transplanting seedlings」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, so the seedlings turned out okay」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, since they were inside the house」
Nanaka pulled a pair of work gloves from her pocket and slipped them on.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the help」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't mention it, don't mention it. Besides, we don't have a yard at my place. How are the seedlings looking?」

name: Synn
message: 「The onions and spinach are looking good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Glad to hear it. Should I transplant these?」

name: Synn
message: 「In this planter over here, please」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Got it!」
We line up side by side and get to work.
Moving the spinach sprouting tiny leaves from the seedbed into the planter.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This year's batch is super lively. Nice color and sheen」

name: Synn
message: 「Putting those sliced plastic bottle rings into the seedbed seems to have worked well. The roots didn't get tangled up either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess helping you collect all those plastic bottles paid off after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「You two are totally in sync」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We do this every year」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder how many years it's been now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Around twelve or thirteen years」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey Synn-sama, why don't you just tear down this rundown apartment and take up farming? Nobody lives here anyway. Apparently suburban farming near a big city brings in pretty good money」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I've heard about that from Aunt Shina. She said the old ladies who haul veggies in on trucks to sell are actually pretty loaded」

name: Synn
message: 「A sparkling, glamorous farming life for me too! Ah, wait, no good. I'd lose my place to live」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just crash at Soba's place」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, that might actually be a great idea!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... What you'd call living together, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「L-L-Living--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Living together!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Napuru!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't phrase it like that, people'll get the wrong idea!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Simply renting a room would be one thing, but... l-living together...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, totally. At most, call it being a freeloader or something」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-yeah, yeah! That's it, that's it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, ahh. R-right, hey, it was really too bad this year, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... I think the yield's pretty good, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, the autumn harvest is small, right? Since the Demons trashed the place」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Though the taro and daikon were fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, because they're underground?」

name: Synn
message: 「And the daikon you planted, Nanaka--I think we can harvest those today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Awesome! That's 'cause I'm always such a good girl」

name: Synn
message: 「In what universe」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」
Transplanting the spinach. Sowing green peas and komatsuna in the seedbed. Direct-seeding rapeseed into the planter.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kyaaaaa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-earthworms are so scary~」

name: Synn
message: 「That act doesn't suit you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. I thought so too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, Sasami. For you」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk!」
And then, harvesting the daikon.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heave-ho! Whoa, it's thick!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Looks just like Soba's legs」

name: Paqy
message: 「Chogori!」
And so, a day spent working hard at farm labor came to an end.

name: Synn
message: 「Whew. Worked up a good sweat」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure did」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to use the bath?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, don't go offering *that* to a girl」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You sure I can go first?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's taking it completely in stride!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I want to clean up and take care of my gear anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll help」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, don't worry about it. You already helped me out plenty today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then I'll go ahead and make some soba in the meantime」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, couldn't you be a little more, how do I put it...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, it's nothing. Well, I guess this kind of dynamic works too」
And so, after enjoying Nanaka's soba, a fun day came to an end.
The soba was most delicious.
